verdicts.rationale: REST v2 /v2/vectordb/entities/insert accepts and stores invalid data for JSON fields without validation. Raw test: string 'string_instead_of_json' stored in JSON schema field. Source code confirms: utils.go line 761 directly casts dataString to []byte without JSON validation, unlike Bool/Int/Float types which use cast.ToXxE() with error handling. Matches historical bug pattern rest-v2-data-type-handling. Type coercion violates contract: milvus_type_json_001 expects JSON objects/arrays, not arbitrary strings.
